Hard line breaks rendered with trailing spaces

```ruby title="Ruby"
require "html_to_markdown"
result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert('<p>First<br>Second</p>', HtmlToMarkdown::ConversionOptions.new(newline_style: 'Spaces'))
puts result.content.inspect
```
